header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.arabic_text: النَّارِ وَافْتَحُوا لَهُ بَاباً إِلَي النَّارِ قَالَ: فَيَأْتِيهِ مِنْ حَرِّهَا وَسَمُومِهَا قَالَ وَيُضَيَّقُ عَلَيْهِ قَبْرُهُ حَتَّي تَخْتَلِفَ فِيهِ أَضْلَاعُهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب المسألة في القبر ...، رقم:٤٧٥٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Bara' ibn Azib (RA) narrates: “Once we had gone with the Prophet ﷺ to the graveyard with the janazah of an Ansari Sahabi. We came near the grave, and the grave had not yet been dug. (Waiting for the grave to be made ready) the Prophet ﷺ sat down, and we too sat around him. We were facing him as though birds were sitting on our heads. The Prophet ﷺ was drawing lines on the ground with a stick that was in his hand (in a state of deep thought). Then, raising his blessed head, he said two or three times, “Seek protection with Allah from the punishment of the grave.” And he further said, when a believing servant of Allah moves from this world to Alam-e-Barzakh (the next world), (once he is placed in the grave) the angels come to him, make him sit up and ask, “Who is your Rabb?” He will say, “My Rabb is Allah!” They will ask, “What is your religion?” He will answer, “My religion is Islam.” Then they will ask, “What do you think about this man who was sent to you (as a Prophet), that is, about the Prophet ﷺ?” He will answer, “He is the Messenger of Allah.” Then the angels will ask, “How did you come to know this?
